name: Temperature
description: Cold Sweat gives you a body temperature.

pages.title: Temperature
pages.text:
Cold Sweat gives you a body temperature. Hot or cold places push it up or down, and if it goes too far you take damage and cannot sleep.

It is a layer of survival, not a puzzle: dress for the biome and keep a heat source nearby.

pages.title: In this pack
pages.text:
Cold Sweat is gentler here: body temperature moves at 0.75 speed, and each hit does half a heart every 2 seconds instead of a full heart.

Spawn can be snowy. Without warm gear you will freeze once the 5 minute grace period ends, so insulate early.

pages.title: Thermometer
pages.text: Shows the temperature of the place you stand in. Your body temperature has its own icon on the HUD.

pages.title: Two numbers
pages.text:
**World temperature** is what the spot feels like: biome, time of day, height or depth, nearby fire, lava or ice, water.

**Body temperature** drifts toward it. Armor insulation and warm or cold blocks slow that drift.

pages.title: Water and danger
pages.text:
Getting wet cools you, and a netherite diving suit makes you immune to that. Heat and cold can both be lethal.

You cannot sleep while overheating or freezing.

After you spawn or die you get Grace, a short immunity to temperature damage.

pages.title: Altitude
pages.text:
Higher is colder. The pack adds [#](2E5AAC)[Cold Sweat: Altitude](entry://survival/temperature_create)[#](), which splits the height range into bands that change temperature, adds a chill message in the sky and lets shelter or tagged armor cut the effect.

Mountains, sky islands and airships are where it bites.

pages.title: Space
pages.text: Cold Sweat covers the Overworld and Aether. Northstar's planets have their own temperature system, set by each world and a Temperature Regulator block. It is separate from Cold Sweat: no link exists between them.

pages.title: Related
pages.text:
Thirst now works with Cold Sweat: see [#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#]().
